article.title: One Palestinian killed, dozens injured during Israeli settler attacks on West Bank olive harvest
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Settler attacks in the West Bank are ongoing with the enthusiastic approval of the Israeli army, as Palestinians are barred from accessing their own land, and their olive groves, for the fourth year in a row.
